entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:1
segments: You [are] the sons of the LORD your God. You shall not cut yourselves nor make [any] baldness between your eyes for the dead.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:2
segments: For you [are] a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a peculiar people to Himself, above all the nations that are on the earth.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:3
segments: You shall not eat any hateful thing.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:4
segments: These [are] the animals which you shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:5
segments: the hart, and the gazelle, and the roe deer, and the wild goat, and the mountain goat, and the wild ox, and the mountain-sheep.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:6
segments: And every animal that divides the hoof, and divides it into two hooves, [and] chews the cud among the animals, that you shall eat.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:7
segments: But these you shall not eat, of those which chew the cud, or of those that divide the cloven hoof: the camel, and the hare, and the rock badger, for they chew the cud, but do not divide the hoof. They [are] unclean to you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:8
segments: And the swine, because it divides the hoof but does not chew the cud; it [is] unclean to you. You shall not eat of their flesh nor touch their dead body.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:9
segments: These you shall eat of all that [are] in the waters: all that have fins and scales you shall eat.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:10
segments: And whatever does not have fins and scales you shall not eat. It [is] unclean to you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:11
segments: You shall eat all clean birds.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:12
segments: But you shall not eat of these: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the osprey,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:13
segments: and the hawk, and the falcon, and the vulture after its kind,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:14
segments: and every raven after its kind,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:15
segments: and the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckoo, and the hawk after its kind,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:16
segments: the little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:17
segments: and the pelican, and the owl, and the cormorant,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:18
segments: and the stork, and the heron after its kind, and the hoopoe, and the bat.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:19
segments: And every creeping thing that flies [is] unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:20
segments: You may eat all clean fowls.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:21
segments: You shall not eat anything that dies of itself. You shall give it to the stranger that [is] in your gates, so that he may eat it. Or you may sell [it] to a stranger. For you [are] a holy people to the LORD your God. You shall not boil a kid in its mother's milk.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:22
segments: You shall truly tithe all the increase of your seed that the field brings forth year by year.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:23
segments: And you shall eat before the LORD your God in the place which He shall choose to place His name there, the tithe of your grain, of your wine, and of your oil, and the first-born of your herds and of your flocks, so that you may learn to fear the LORD your God always.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:24
segments: And if the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it, [or] if the place is too far from you, which the LORD your God shall choose to set His name there, when the LORD your God has blessed you,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:25
segments: then you shall turn [it] into silver and bind up the silver in your hand, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:26
segments: And you shall pay that silver for whatever your soul desires, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul desires. And you shall eat there before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:27
segments: and the Levite within your gates, you shall not forsake him, for he has no part nor inheritance with you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:28
segments: At the end of three years you shall bring forth all the tithe of your increase the same year, and shall lay [it] up inside your gates.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 14:29
segments: And the Levite, because he has no part nor inheritance with you, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, who [are] inside your gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.
